name: יִגְדַּלְיָהוּ
gloss: Yah will be great; may Yah be great
summary: Igdaliah, father of Hanan, “the man of God”, whose sons had a chamber in the house of Yahweh where Jeremiah brought the Rechabites (Jer 35:4). The name is the qal imperfect of גָּדַל with the divine name, the very words of the psalms: יִגְדַּל יַהְוֶה, “let Yahweh be great” (Psa 35:27; 40:17), “Yahweh is great beyond the border of Israel” (Mal 1:5).

evidence.note: “The chamber of the sons of Hanan בֶּן־יִגְדַּלְיָהוּ, the man of God.”
“Let them say continually, יִגְדַּל יַהְוֶה”: the name's two words.

note: Whether “the man of God” is Hanan or Igdaliah the verse does not settle.
